Why we own it Why we own Nu is the largest digital bank in Latin America, operating under the Nubank brand across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia. They have 139mn customers with 118mn in Brazil, where it now touches well over half the adult population, 16mn in Mexico, where management says it has become the country's largest digital bank, and 5+mn in Colombia, its earliest-stage market. Positives Positives - First-ever $1B net-income quarter, with net income reaching $1.06bn, up 49% YoY and 17% QoQ on a constant currency basis. Margin inflected, with risk-adjusted net interest margin climbing 290bps sequentially to a record 12.4% from 9.5% in Q1, which management framed as the first clear evidence that credit-cost normalization is under way alongside continued monetization gains.

Negatives Negatives - Management noted macro caution in Brazil requiring vigilance on consumer credit. The efficiency ratio rose to 19.5% from 17.6% in Q1 as operating expenses jumped 20% QoQ to $806mn on real-estate and marketing expense timing plus continued international (US, Mexico) build-out costs.
